newsitem.title: UK: UK watchdog seeks comment on FirstBus deal.
newsitem.headline: UK watchdog seeks comment on FirstBus deal.

text.p: Britain's competition watchdog the Office of Fair Trading said on Wednesday it is considering whether FirstBus Plc's proposed purchase of CentreWest Ltd warrants a monopoly investigation.
The OFT is inviting comment on the proposed deal and its implications for competition by March 5.

Earlier on Wednesday bus and coach operator FirstBus announced plans to buy CentreWest, offering 2.5 FirstBus shares for each CentreWest share. The offer valued CentreWest's share capital at about 24 million stg.
CentreWest runs local bus services in west, central and south east London under contract to London Transport Buses.
